name: arena_free_all
notes: SR2 new (matcher paired it with SR1 arena_low_shrink); frees both arenas at exit

name: ega_present
notes: EGA/VGA card found by `ega_vga_detect` (1 = EGA BIOS answered, 2 = colour CRTC only); SR1 DS:0250

name: ega_lowres_sw
notes: EGA info CL says switches 1/14 (set -> `ega_present = 1`); SR1 DS:0252

name: g_vga
notes: 1 = VGA (EGA driver with VGA split-screen); set by `video_detect_menu`/`driver_select`; SR1 DS:0254

name: video_menu_title
notes: "STREET ROD II:  Video Options" + 2 newlines (text menu strings `0127 / 0147 / 016F`, menu line table `DS:01A2..01AC`); SR1 DS:019B ..

name: wait_last
notes: `wait_ticks` completion time of the previous call (DS:1D02/1D04)

name: mouse_dx
notes: scaled mouse delta x (`mouse_poll`); SR1 DS:05E2

name: mouse_dy
notes: scaled mouse delta y; SR1 DS:05E4

name: mouse_shift_x
notes: mickey -> pixel shift x; SR1 DS:05EA

name: mouse_shift_y
notes: mickey -> pixel shift y (changed by `race_isr_enter/leave`); SR1 DS:05EC

name: mouse_present
notes: non-zero when a mouse driver answered (`input_poll_any` polls it)

name: ticks
notes: tick counter (72.8 Hz timer ISR; DS:1F66/1F68); SR1 DS:05F8

name: kbd_saved_pairs
notes: saved `{scan, old key}` pairs of the per-screen key remap, 0-terminated (`DS:1FBE` = first scan code, 0 = no remap); SR1 DS:0650 (+ flag DS:064E)

name: joy_x
notes: joystick centre / axis words (`joy_read`, calibration); SR1 DS:4718

name: joy_buttons
notes: joystick buttons (bits 4-5 of port 201h, inverted); SR1 DS:471C

name: kbd_dir_x
notes: sum of held direction keys, x; SR1 DS:472E

name: kbd_dir_y
notes: sum of held direction keys, y; SR1 DS:472F

name: click_held
notes: bit 0 key, bit 1 joystick, bit 2 mouse button held; SR1 DS:4732

name: cursor_visible
notes: pointer show/hide nesting counter (`cursor_ctl`); SR1 DS:4733

name: click_code
notes: pending primary click code (1 mouse, 0x1F key, joy buttons); SR1 DS:4736

name: click2_code
notes: pending secondary click code (0x1E); SR1 DS:4737

name: click_x
notes: position of the pending click; SR1 DS:4738

name: click2_x
notes: position of the secondary click; SR1 DS:473C

name: kbd_dir_lock
notes: interrupt-side lock byte (only cleared by the ISR in SR2); SR1 DS:4740

name: cursor_hot_x
notes: pointer hot spot x (set by `cursor_ctl`); SR1 DS:4742

name: cursor_hot_y
notes: pointer hot spot y; SR1 DS:4744

name: race_saved_cursor_x
notes: saved pointer position (`cursor_init` clears); SR1 DS:4746

name: kbd_xlat
notes: scan code -> key code table (patched per screen); `+0x33/+0x34` = `,` `.` entries toggled by `kbd_text_mode_on/off`; SR1 DS:4766

name: click_edge
notes: set with every primary click key press; SR1 DS:47CD

name: sound_gate
notes: sound routines run only when non-zero; SR1 DS:47CF

name: key
notes: the one-byte key "queue" (`key_read` read-and-clear); SR1 DS:47D0

name: kbd_held_flags
notes: held flags of the direction keys, indexed by (-k); also `joy_saved_sp` (word at `DS:3BF0`); SR1 DS:47E8

name: click_seen
notes: "any click / Esc" flag set by `kbd_isr`, `input_poll_any`, polled by wait loops; SR1 DS:47EE

name: status_label_text
notes: status label string used by `gfx_screen_mode(3)`; SR1 DS:49DE

name: g_vram_pool_used
notes: bytes used in each of the four VRAM picture-cache pools; base far pointer `DS:490E:4910` (A000:0000), pools start at +0x7D00; SR1 DS:4C18 / 4C14

name: lib1_handle
notes: LIB1 file handle (0 = closed); SR1 DS:4ED8

name: crit_err_off
notes: non-zero -> `crit_err_handler` returns at once; only ever cleared (by `lib_open_all`)

name: msg_insert_disk
notes: "Insert disk ? into drive ?" (`[0xC]` disk number char, `[0x19]` drive letter patched); SR1 DS:4EE4

name: msg_not_found
notes: "File not found: " (+ name copied to offset 0x10 by `file_not_found`); SR1 DS:4EEC

name: msg_no_memory
notes: "Not enough memory to run Street Rod !"; SR1 DS:4BEE

name: run_counts
notes: `pic_unpack` run lengths of the 16 tokens; SR1 DS:4EEE

name: run_values
notes: `pic_unpack` run values (00 or FF); SR1 DS:4EFE

name: arena2_used
notes: bytes already used in arena 2 by `arena_bitmap_alloc(pool -1)`

name: shp_directory
notes: `SR2_SHP` directory, 26 x 8 bytes `{u32 offset, u16 size, u16 0}`

name: shp_b_ptrs
notes: destination pointers of the format-B shape sets (index relative to `DS:81DA`)

name: shp_a_ptrs
notes: destination pointers of the format-A shape sets (index = set id)

name: dgroup_seg
notes: DGROUP segment value (`get_ds`); `far_alloc` rejects blocks in it; SR1 DS:6C60

name: cur_drive
notes: DOS drive at start-up (1 = A:, 3 = C:); SR1 DS:6C68

name: cur_lib_count
notes: pointer to the entry count of the current library (`DS:B8CA / B8D6 / B8DA`); SR1 DS:6C6A

name: cur_lib_handle
notes: pointer to the handle of the current library; SR1 DS:6C6C

name: cur_lib_name
notes: pointer to the path of the current library; SR1 DS:6C6E

name: prev_lib_handle
notes: handle pointer of the previously selected library (closed on a switch); SR1 DS:6C70

name: picdir_seg
notes: segment of the picture directory (0x3726); entries of 0x22 bytes; SR1 DS:691C (seg 389B)

name: amblksiz
notes: C heap growth chunk (set 0x800 by `mem_pools_init`, 0x400 by `_myalloc`); SR1 DS:64A6

name: arena2
notes: **second arena (new)**: `DS:A9D6` bytes (45000 VGA); `arena_bitmap_alloc(-1)` and shape sets

name: floppy_drives
notes: number of usable floppy drives (1 or 2) from `lib_open_all`

name: arena_top
notes: end of the top (mode 3) region of arena 1 (65000); SR1 DS:78DE

name: arena_low_depth
notes: depth of the low stack (mode 1); SR1 DS:7B14

name: arena_top_index
notes: index of the top stack (mode 2), starts 0x3C; SR1 DS:7D80

name: cpu_speed
notes: `cpu_speed_calibrate` result (polls per 55 ms tick / 950, minimum 1); SR1 DS:8ACC

name: arena_w
notes: arena allocation table W (W[0x3C] = `DS:B864`); SR1 DS:8B02

name: arena_perm
notes: permanent bump pointer of arena 1; SR1 DS:8F00

name: lib1_path
notes: pointer to the LIB1 path string (`?:lib1` / `?:lib1c`); SR1 DS:8DD4

name: ui_level
notes: 2 = after `cursor_init` (SR1: used by menus); SR1 DS:8247

name: video_mode_init
notes: SR2 new; BIOS mode set per video choice (S3.7)

name: kbd_hotspot_refresh
notes: SR2 new; rebuilds DS:3B6E hot-key remap (S3.7)

name: bios_mode_a_set
notes: SR2 new in index; = SR1 0000:2b9a bios_mode_a_set (S3.7)
